title: Leer's neodymium magnet treatment for Mitchell's knee implant

tellings.quote: um my arm and Dr. Lear uh he thought maybe there wip might be one in my knee. It was like a weak signal. So he sent me a 100 lb neodymium magnet

plain: A man named Eric Mitchell says that Dr. Roger Leir, a doctor who looked for what he believed were alien implants in people's bodies, picked up a weak signal suggesting there might be one in Mitchell's knee, as well as in his arm. Mitchell tells Michels that Leir sent him a 100-pound neodymium magnet, a very strong kind of magnet, to treat it. If true, it would mean objects in his body responded to magnets.
